profile.description: Oman Telecommunications Company SAOG, together with its subsidiaries, establishes, operates, develops, and maintains telecommunication services in the Sultanate of Oman and internationally. It offers mobile services, including postpaid, prepaid, data, and other services and add-ons; fixed line, session initiation protocol trunk, fixed-mobile CPN, international and conference call services, and digital voice services; Internet services, such as 5G, fiber pro, and internet plans for schools and colleges; and business solutions comprising bill analyzers and network performance management portal. The company also provides cloud computing services, such as cloud and data center, software as a service, platform as a service, infrastructure as a service, managed, unified communications and collaborations, cyber security, and internet of things and artificial intelligence. In addition, it provides connectivity solutions, such as multi-protocol label switching, ethernet, national leased line, international private leased circuits, very small aperture terminal, and Inmarsat services. Further, the company offers home services, value added services, permit services, emergency, voice mail, money transfer, permit, family and friends, and other services. Oman Telecommunications Company SAOG was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Muscat, the Sultanate of Oman.
